changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO `role_permission` (`role_id`, `p_id`, `create_time`, `update_time`) SELECT 1, p_id, NOW(), NOW() FROM permission WHERE code IN ('order:unresolved', 'order:history', 'order:all', 'order:setting');

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dept_permission WHERE p_id = (SELECT p_id FROM (SELECT p_id FROM permission WHERE code = 'order') t)

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO `dept_permission` (`dept_id`, `p_id`, `create_time`, `update_time`) SELECT d.dept_id, p.p_id, NOW(), NOW() FROM department d, permission p WHERE p.code IN ('order', 'order:unresolved', 'order:history', 'order:all', 'order:setting');
